Thermal Self-Observation

I want to use a thermal camera to observe warm spots across my head, chest and body while working at my laptop, and explore how those patterns change over a work session.

An early affective-computing portfolio concept for my MIT Media Lab application, not a completed experiment. I plan to pair thermal observations with my own notes about the experience.

Thermal images show surface temperature, not emotions or core body temperature. Clothing, room temperature, movement and camera position affect readings; connections to subjective state remain questions to investigate, not validated claims.
